narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Take three and five. The sum is eight, and eight times eight is sixty four.
<bookmark mark='half'/>Read the trick again. The second number is half of the sum, which is four.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>He used the whole sum twice, so his result is too big.

narration: <bookmark mark='c1'/>To check, run the trick on a pair of numbers of your own.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Then square their sum, halve it, and see that both results match.
